title: Reduction of the Prepay Ceiling Share where Service Charges Stand on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
An account that has carried a service charge in the season has the share of its prior season spend it may book as prepay cut, and the cut is the heavier where nothing has been paid onto the account since.

**Clause.** Where a service charge stands assessed on the account over the 14 statement months before the handling date and a payment has also been posted to it over those months, the reduction taken off the ceiling share is 10 percent. Where a service charge stands assessed on the account over those months and no payment has been posted to it over those months, the reduction taken off the ceiling share is 25 percent. In every other case no reduction is taken off the ceiling share on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

### Input, judgement, result

- *Service charges standing over the 14 statement months:* 1; *payments posted over those months:* 3 → **reduction 10 percent**
- *Service charges standing over the 14 statement months:* 2; *payments posted over those months:* none → **reduction 25 percent**
- *Service charges standing over the 14 statement months:* none; *payments posted over those months:* none → **no reduction is taken**

The reduction is expressed in the same terms as the ceiling share and is taken off that share before the share is applied to the prior season spend, so a ceiling share of 100 percent carrying a reduction of 25 percent leaves a share of 75 percent. One service charge standing inside the window is enough to bring the clause into play; the count of them beyond one does not change which of the two reductions is taken.
